history.purpose: Music workspace: the prompt editor, model and lyrics controls, the Generate button, and the list of generated projects (tracks).
history.ready_when: track rows are rendered, or the empty-state text is shown. After a navigation the list shows skeleton rows for several seconds while the history API answers - wait for the specific card, not a fixed delay.

project.purpose: One project. Not used directly: its URL is how a track is identified, because list positions shift on every rerender and deletion.

navigation: Everything runs on the history page; reload it with navigate(https://elevenlabs.io/app/music/history) to get a fresh list.
Project id = last path segment of the row's /app/music/project/ link.
